mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, SUM(b.amount) AS amount FROM bills b INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND b.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND b.transaction_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, c.id ASC
